hero.title: PRAPTI
hero.subtitle: // CITIZEN BENEFITS COMPANION & ELIGIBILITY ENGINE
hero.description: Your personal citizen benefits companion, helping you and your family discover verified government schemes, understand eligibility, and prepare claims with zero identity number collection.

features.title: Deterministic Eligibility & Privacy by Design
features.card1Desc: Citizens belong to overlapping groups. A female college student from a farming family qualifies across student, women, and rural benefit categories simultaneously.
features.card2Desc: Generative AI is strictly forbidden from inventing rules or deciding eligibility. Rules evaluate to PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN with complete audit traces and gazette citations.
features.card3Desc: PRAPTI never asks for Aadhaar numbers, PAN, or voter ID strings. Document availability is tracked as readiness flags, preserving citizen dignity and data safety.
